scope: Targeted generation-bound TCP connection/listener readiness instead of a common activity broadcast.

implementation.ownership: Mandatory native TCP owner; resident non-owning readiness projection and per-condition queues. Existing waitable TCP task guard remains authoritative; no new module, public API or resource registry.
implementation.publication: Capture small copied observations under the TCP task owner. Runtime admission publishes identity/flags and matching wakes together. Predicates read only atomics in O(1), never acquire TCP admission, and retain no connection/table pointer across sleep. No TCP/runtime owner spans the actual wait.
implementation.events: Separate connection established/readable/closed and listener accept/data queues. Positive relevant readiness or identity retirement wakes only those queues. All native TCP releases cover RX, ACK state, local writes, claim, close, abort and maintenance/retirement. Remove the old explicit RX-wide broadcast; unchanged readiness performs no atomic stores/wakes.
implementation.lifetimes: Operation captures a slot/ID/native-generation connection ticket or slot/port/non-reused-generation listener ticket once. Slot or port reuse retires the old wait. Incoming connections retain their listener generation. Exact listener queries/finish cannot adopt or close a replacement; old cleanup aborts only children of its own listener generation. Listener generation exhaustion refuses new admission instead of wrapping.
implementation.preserved: Public R4NET tables/records, existing native read predicate/results, packet/RTO algorithms, size/copy limits, fixed250-ms wait slices and deadlines. Internal connection/listener layouts are private native owner storage. A retired operation returns its existing bad-state/error form.
implementation.counters: Native tcp_sig now sums actually woken tasks, previously received-segment broadcasts. Base-mode operational availability remains; cross-version counts are not identical units. No score/workload/reference change.
implementation.diagnostic: Extend only the existing TCP performance-contract category after releasing its old TCP guard. Eleven exact own task incarnations, two independent readers, established/closed, data before enrollment, actual timeout, connection slot reuse, listener accept/data/reopen and late old cleanup. Gate/ledger/fixtures remain resident on failed cleanup; no foreign slot/queue reset.

source_audit.unchanged: TCP packet/RTO algorithms, all six original native TCP probe bodies and their oracles, TCP task guard, public R4NET implementation/Contract/SDK/Spectra, scheduler queues/physical switch and task unwind. Only readiness/lifetime clients and one existing probe wrapper change.
source_audit.projection_review: TCP task owner captures resident scalar observations before runtime admission; complete atomic publication plus matching wakes under runtime owner. Scheduler predicate only reads direct-slot atomics. Targets capture once and reject different lifetime; original readable predicate and250ms/deadline policies retained. No global activity queue or RX broadcast.
source_audit.abi: Internal Connection/Listener records gain listener lifetime; no public table/record or module ABI change. Telemetry tcp_sig semantic boundary documented.
source_audit.scope: Source preservation review, not an additional runtime/throughput proof.

scoped_guest.scope: Final current-source NETWORK LIMIT passes after correcting only the new diagnostic abort expectation. Original TCP/IPC passed in the first guest; carried forward with exact production-source equivalence, not rerun. All original frontend assertions remain.

failed_attempts.reason: Probe expected the native identity to remain live after abort; original unchanged TCP abort sets used=false and retires it immediately. Target.wait returns whether the captured identity is still current. Both waiters must finish with false.

comparison_previous.observation: One final run per artifact; descriptive comparison without causal gain/parity claim. All deltas retained, unchanged workload/reference, no score-selection rerun.

New private diagnostic expected a live identity after abort and failed at phase2; cleanup completed, original TCP/IPC passed. Preserve that guest and repeat only LIMIT after correcting exactly two new diagnostic expected values. Production source and the original frontend assertions unchanged, demonstrated by complete build-source hashes. Preliminary compiler candidates ran no guest or STANDARD. No new general suite, broad catalogue, throughput campaign, loss injection or extra benchmark.
